english.title: Distributor fail to comply with take back scheme or submit application to Secretary of State

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a distributor to whom regulation 42(2) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 applied, and who did not provide in-store take back and had not joined a distributor take back scheme approved by the Secretary of State under regulation 68 of those regulations, failed to either comply with all the obligations which a take back scheme must discharge on behalf of its members or submit an application in accordance with regulation 69(2) of those regulations to the Secretary of State requesting to use existing take back facilities
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 69, 90(5) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
